text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's!
Not that I have any special plans, though!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Or so it was supposed to go.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Today's video project is... this!
"The Heart-Throbbing Valentine's Confession Championship"~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the judging will be handled by
the 65 invited fans!
Everyone, please lend us your help~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Okay♪" "Love-chan♡"
"We'll keep it a secret until the stream day!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...For some reason, I spent that day watching Kiseki participate in an event hosted by the streamer Umamusume, Loves Only You, from the spectator seats.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I learn so much from Loves-chan's projects!
Her vibe and the way she gets everyone around her involved and hyped up!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —If I'm entering, I'm aiming for victory with everything I've got, though!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I'll give a heart-throbbing confession too!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I, Lucky Lilac,
will be hosting.
As for the other participants...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I will do... my absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
A confession—to this tournament where love flows around—...
If I could be one of the people who adds color to it—I would be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how precious.
Shall we begin the "Valentine's Heart-Throbbing Confession Championship," then?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well then, as the host,
allow me to demonstrate first♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...I know what you desire."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...I know what you desire."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I put so much care into making it.
—My one and only love."

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~!
Gimme that, gimme that, giiimmeee it~!
Love-chan, I love you so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Wait, she's going full throttle?!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (That's an example, right?! That's merciless, you know?! Raising the bar so high right off the bat...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Next up is, C-Chrono Genesis...!
...Here I go...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, Chrono-chan is next!?
Are you okay going after this!? Good luck, okay!?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Chrono-chan is a total race fanatic, so I bet even her confession would be—... ............Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What does a confession from a racing fanatic even look like?
Information overload? A full presentation? Giving you super high-res photos...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I... I love you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Badump...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ Wonderful! Taking the classic,
simple route, Chrono-chan!
choice_data_list: (Everyone around us is clutching their chests!?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, isn't Chrono-chan pretty amazing too...?
Doesn't it feel like she's getting the hang of making hearts flutter...?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Could it be that in this tournament... I'm the only one who's basically a beginner...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...!? This notification is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, what flashed through Kiseki's mind
—was the phrase 'Divine Revelation.'

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If this were a manga, getting a message
when you're cornered in a pinch would be "salvation"...
a hint for a comeback move.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this, too, is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The shoujo manga I borrowed from you
was so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Tsundere? That's cute too, isn't it♪"
"The gap moe totally stole my heart!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmh, ngh...! Thank you for your feedback...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (A breakthrough isn't gonna just magically fall into our laps, now is it~!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what...!?
...—Shoujo manga...? Gap moe—?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: (—!? Kiseki, did you get a flash of inspiration!?)
(—!? Kiseki, did you get a flash of inspiration!?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's your turn next, Kiseki-san.
Please step into the confession booth.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Hehehe, that's fine...! I still had this trick up my sleeve, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Focus. Don't get too worked up.
Today, I'm not a shonen manga protagonist...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (What I'm pulling off—is a real "shojo manga" miracle!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Geez☆ You're so slow!
<username>-kun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Geez☆ You're so slow!
<username>-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We promised we'd walk to school together today.
Did you forget about it!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph, I don't wanna hear your excuses!
I'm mad at you, so there!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'll get mad, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I 'reserved' it ahead of time
so I'd be the very first to get your Valentine's."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how adorable~.
A soft side hidden beneath that pout.
Looks like the customers are loving it too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Oh? Loves-chan?
What's the matter? Why the big rush...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
P-Personal info...!
That was totally personal info just now...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haah--?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
we signed the agreement allowing the name to appear in the video,
and the filming concluded smoothly.
choice_data_list: There's really no need to feel down about it, though.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I caused needless trouble
for both Loves-chan and Trainer-san, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I need to study a lot more...
Both how to do it and what to watch out for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We headed back while comforting Kiseki,
who had become unusually downcast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, I felt like Kiseki and I
kept making eye contact.
It was as if her gaze was piercing right through me...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Over here.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look at me.
...Just for now, take me seriously.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It was drawn in a shoujo manga
I read a while back."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"When hearts truly connect,
it creates an excitement that sweeps up everyone around them," they say.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then I can't imagine anyone else!
No one understands me better than you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The miracle of your hero is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It is also a miracle created by your heroine.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't hand over my spot as number one.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And I won't let go of being your number one either.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Come—reach out your hand!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I love you!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, what a lovely confession.
So gentle, yet brimming with passion.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, the secret is that it's totally not like my usual self!
That's the appeal of gap moe!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Though there were parts where I couldn't really turn it into gap moe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with the filming concluded, the votes were tallied...
Chrono Genesis clinched 1st place in the championship."
choice_data_list: ...I really thought Kiseki was gonna get 1st place, though.
...And here I thought Kiseki was going to take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha,
but it was a good learning experience, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"There are still plenty of genres I can tackle besides shonen manga!
I figured I gotta make full use of that!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Besides, if it's us—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Because I was absolutely certain that if it's us,
we can get everyone around us involved!!
